notes: Each town gets some flavour from the games set in its city: start at the Seabreeze Hotel (your first safehouse) on Ocean Drive with a lighthouse, lifeguards, mopeds and neon underglow; rooftop water tanks and billboards in Ironwood Central; hill letters, an observatory, sidewalk stars and a beach court in Palm Heights. Faster drawing of far props and trees; a crash fix for crime reports outside town.
